units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>This telescope... wow, to think that you still have it. I thought it went the way of the observatory, destroyed long ago.</color>
units.displayText: This telescope... wow, to think that you still have it. I thought it went the way of the observatory, destroyed long ago.

spans.text: This telescope... wow, to think that you still have it. I thought it went the way of the observatory, destroyed long ago.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Allow me to make some adjustments... see, starlight from eons ago has finally arrived.</color>
units.displayText: Allow me to make some adjustments... see, starlight from eons ago has finally arrived.

spans.text: Allow me to make some adjustments... see, starlight from eons ago has finally arrived.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Even if its original recipient had no doubt ceased to be many years ago too. Forlorn, yet so magnificent... no matter, let us receive these gifts in their place.</color>
units.displayText: Even if its original recipient had no doubt ceased to be many years ago too. Forlorn, yet so magnificent... no matter, let us receive these gifts in their place.

spans.text: Even if its original recipient had no doubt ceased to be many years ago too. Forlorn, yet so magnificent... no matter, let us receive these gifts in their place.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>A journey's end need not be what was originally intended, and things are lovely as they are, no?</color>
units.displayText: A journey's end need not be what was originally intended, and things are lovely as they are, no?

spans.text: A journey's end need not be what was originally intended, and things are lovely as they are, no?

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>...So, will you leave behind your work here, and fly away with me into the serene darkness, where we may gaze at the stars?</color>
units.displayText: ...So, will you leave behind your work here, and fly away with me into the serene darkness, where we may gaze at the stars?

spans.text: ...So, will you leave behind your work here, and fly away with me into the serene darkness, where we may gaze at the stars?

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>...Found me out, have you? Hehe... then we shall proceed as you desire, and continue with you leading me in my orbit. Until you are tired enough to hand everything over to me…</color>
units.displayText: ...Found me out, have you? Hehe... then we shall proceed as you desire, and continue with you leading me in my orbit. Until you are tired enough to hand everything over to me…
